plan.notes: Official four-year plan page from Seattle University (College of Science and Engineering), 2026-2027. Quarter-Based Degree Plan transcribed. Lecture+lab bundles split into their real course codes at the published split credits. The CHEM 1520 (4) / CHEM 1590 (5) choice transcribed at 4 cr; MATH 1028 Trigonometry (2 cr, only if needed) transcribed as a 0-cr choice slot. Quarter sums: 16/16/14/15/15/15/15/15/15/17/15/12 = 180, matching the minimum to graduate. Curriculum notes: at least 25 cr of 3000/4000-level BIOL; BIOL electives must include one plant course plus one course from each of three groups (BIOL 2350/2360/2520/2530; BIOL 4620/4630/4640/4650/4660; BIOL 3250/3300/3800/3820/3850/3880/3890); Natural Science elective = BIOL 2350+, CHEM 2100+, ENSC 3000+, or PHYS 2000+; Social Sciences/Humanities elective = EVST 3500, HIST 3510, or PLSC 3000; C- or better required in prerequisite BIOL/CHEM/MATH. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
